task_relevant_facts: SH0ES uses a simultaneous chi-square / covariance fit across geometric anchors, Cepheid distances, calibrator SNe Ia, and Hubble-flow SNe Ia.
Riess et al. report baseline Cepheid-SN Ia H0 = 73.04 +/- 1.04 km/s/Mpc, TRGB-included 72.53 +/- 0.99, and high-redshift-included 73.30 +/- 1.04.
Planck Lambda-CDM comparison value in the related work is H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km/s/Mpc.
The SMC anchor paper reports four-anchor H0 = 73.17 +/- 0.86 and emphasizes covariance between LMC and SMC distances.
The JWST preview motivates multiple primary indicators (Cepheid, TRGB, JAGB) in SN hosts and indicates approximately 0.05 mag statistical distances may be feasible with JWST.
Pantheon+ emphasizes systematic covariance and peculiar-velocity/redshift treatment for SNe Ia in the Hubble flow.
contract_implications: Use covariance-weighted fitting rather than simple unweighted averages.
Include anchor/indicator variants and Hubble tension comparison.
State that the minimal dataset contains only Cepheid/TRGB primary indicators and SN Ia/SBF secondary indicators, so Miras/JAGB/SNe II/FP/TF from the full task cannot be implemented directly.
